001package services;
002
003import java.io.*;
004import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.Date;
007import java.util.List;
008
009/** Simple file-backed application logger. */
010public class Logger implements Serializable {
011    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
012    private static final String LOG_FILE = "app.log";
013    private static final List<String> logs = new ArrayList<>();
014    private static final SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss");
015
016    public static void log(String message) {
017        String entry = "[" + dateFormat.format(new Date()) + "] " + message;
018        logs.add(entry);
019        writeToFile(entry);
020    }
021
022    private static void writeToFile(String entry) {
023        try (FileWriter fw = new FileWriter(LOG_FILE, true);
024             BufferedWriter bw = new BufferedWriter(fw)) {
025            bw.write(entry);
026            bw.newLine();
027        } catch (IOException e) {
028            System.err.println("Log write error: " + e.getMessage());
029        }
030    }
031
032    public static List<String> getLogs() {
033        return new ArrayList<>(logs);
034    }
035
036    public static List<String> getLogsByUser(String userId) {
037        List<String> userLogs = new ArrayList<>();
038        for (String log : logs) {
039            if (log.contains(userId)) {
040                userLogs.add(log);
041            }
042        }
043        return userLogs;
044    }
045
046    public static void clear() {
047        logs.clear();
048        new File(LOG_FILE).delete();
049    }
050}
